derivation: or תּוֹך; (Psalm 72:14), from the same base as H8432 (תָּוֶךְ) (in the sense of cutting to pieces);

occurrences.text: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.
Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.
He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.
